record.paper_title: Mathematical open problems in Projected Entangled Pair States
record.original_question: Let T be a primitive quantum channel acting on D × D matrices, where the primitivity index p(T) is the smallest n such that T^n(ρ) has full rank for every positive semidefinite input ρ. What is the exact best possible upper bound on p(T) as a function of the dimension D?

evidence.quote: Definition 5 A quantum channel is called primitive if there exists an n ∈ N so that T^n(ρ) is full rank for all positive semi-definite input ρ. The minimum of such n is called the primitivity index p(T ).
Question 2 Which is the optimal upper bound for the primitivity index of a primitive quantum channel T acting on MD×D?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D \geq 2$ be a positive integer and let $M_D$ denote the algebra of $D \times D$ complex matrices. A linear map $T: M_D \to M_D$ is called a quantum channel if it is completely positive and trace-preserving. Such a channel is called primitive if there exists $n \in \mathbb{N}$ such that $T^n(\rho)$ has full rank for every positive semidefinite matrix $\rho \in M_D$ with $\rho \neq 0$. The smallest such $n$ is called the primitivity index $p(T)$.

Determine the exact (sharp) value of
$$ f(D) := \max\{\, p(T) : T \text{ is a primitive quantum channel on } M_D \,\}, $$
as an explicit function of $D$. That is, find the optimal upper bound on the primitivity index $p(T)$ over all primitive quantum channels acting on $M_D$, together with a matching family of examples achieving the bound.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact optimal upper bound is not known. The best general upper bound is $O(D^2 \log D)$ (Sanz–Pérez-García–Wolf–Cirac), and it is conjectured the optimal order is $\Theta(D^2)$. Recent work (Rahaman; Ekblad 2025) establishes a bound of $2(D-1)^2$ for primitive Schwarz/2-positive maps, of optimal order but with a constant factor whose sharpness is not known. Thus the problem of identifying the exact sharp constant/value remains open.

status_evidence.title: A note on the quantum Wielandt inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Index of primitivity of any primitive unital Schwarz map is at most 2(D-1)^2; sharpness of the constant factor is not known.
status_evidence.claim: Best known bound is O(D^2) but the sharp constant remains undetermined.

status_evidence.title: A new bound on quantum Wielandt inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Best general bound to date is O(n^2 log n); conjectured optimal order is O(n^2).
status_evidence.claim: Exact optimal bound is conjectural and open.

status_evidence.title: A generic quantum Wielandt's inequality
status_evidence.snippet: Generically the primitivity index is Theta(log n), with the worst case conjectured to be O(n^2).
status_evidence.claim: Worst-case sharp bound remains an open problem.
